claims.claim: Advance polls drew 44,049 voters Oct. 6–11, 2026, up 57 per cent from 28,052 in 2022
Advance totals: 19,188 in 2018, 28,052 in 2022, 24,731 in the 2024 by-election
Oct. 11 was the highest single day with 12,335 ballots; Meadowvale Community Centre led locations at 3,352
Election day is Monday, Oct. 26, 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., with voters choosing mayor, city/regional councillor and school trustee
14 mayoral candidates and 75 ward candidates registered; Ward 7 has the largest field at 17
Parrish is the sitting mayor, Crombie a former mayor, Tedjo and Damerla sitting councillors who left their ward races to run for mayor
Mid-August Liaison Strategies poll had Parrish and Crombie tied at 26 per cent, Damerla 13, Tedjo 9, with 26 per cent undecided
An end-of-September Mainstreet Research poll had Crombie as the top choice with others slightly behind
The four front-runners prioritize affordability, crime and transportation; Damerla also focuses on City Hall accountability
Crombie says she would cancel the Living Arts Centre redevelopment; Tedjo and Damerla also oppose it; Parrish backs the concept
Full Mainstreet poll numbers and the certified candidate list beyond VoterServices were not located
